notes.title: Beek: Familiar Spirit - Remastered v2.1
notes.content:
[b]Just days after release, a new update to Beek is here.[/b] This update aims to address some of the immediate player feedback with some improvements to the game mechanics!

[b]For the detailed list of changes implemented with Beek: Familiar Spirit - Remastered v2.1, please read on below.[/b]

- From the team at Studio Klondike

[h2]Bookmarks Menu[/h2][hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45566348/24a90d181e21d94711aafe156b7e0a4d69494cb3.png[/img]

[b]The Bookmark limit has been increased from 4 to 12.[/b] Bookmarks now also indicate the last message received, along with displaying icons for the current route. (Veeph, Akro, and Bramir)

[h2]Message Skip Tutorial[/h2][hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45566348/e3a86c7426c73f2f0b8810558f395872f8e6ccea.png[/img]

[b]A new tutorial indicator has been added to help teach the player how to skip previously seen text.[/b] This indicator will disappear after the player has clicked the message skip button.

[h2]Fast Mode[/h2][hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45566348/8158d7da0edd946da3f03ed22de638b9b0871acf.png[/img]

[b]A Fast Mode button has been added to the Settings.[/b] While active, the game will progress at 5x speed. This may be particularly useful on a second playthrough.

[h2]Additional Changes[/h2][hr][/hr][list]
[*] A bug that caused a soft-lock on Day 4 has been resolved.
[/list]

notes.title: Beek: Familiar Spirit - Remastered is out now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45566348/cf98458fdd3c1b23cb685bdda390f37768d8d05a.png[/img]
[b]Beek: How I Became a Familiar Spirit and Everything After That returns, now better than ever![/b] The furry texting adventure isekai— rebuilt with updated gameplay mechanics, updated game engine, and a new English script.

[h2]Rebuilt from the ground up![/h2][hr][/hr]
[b]With this Remastered project our team wanted to ensure that Beek remains playable long into the future.[/b] We remade the game from scratch on an updated game engine, adding heaps of quality of life features and tweaks along the way.

[h2]A messaging app connecting you to another world.[/h2][hr][/hr]
The Steam release of Beek features an immersive interface, with tweaks to the real-time elements from the original game to make it possible to play in a continuous session.

[b]We hope that this remaster gives new and returning players an even better chance to experience Beek! [/b]

- From the team at Studio Klondike



[i]It’s a promise... one day we'll meet again.[/i]
